front.title: Outerprise Entry and the Four Gates for Startup Survival

abstract.t: This document describes how a startup can present an independently assessed detached service for institutional review before either party commits to integration. Outerprise Entry precedes four gates: Validation, Trust, Engagement, and Procurement. Signed records identify what an institution received and what each authorized party decided or completed. A startup can retain evidence of progress even when procurement does not follow. An Outer Pilot is a bounded evaluation within Engagement. An Outerprise Waste Metric (OWM) Card preserves the institution's reported cost comparison as an integrity attestation.
